product.name: AmazonBasics 2-Tier Stackable Storage Shelf
product.description: Two-tiered shelving unit system with modular, stackable design Durable metal frame with powder-coated black finish Lightweight and compact design; great for small spaces Stackable design allows you to stack one on top of another for four levels of storage Includes one wire mesh shelf on the lower level and one MDF wood shelf on top
